description: This file declares the interface and class definitions for GstCapabilities and its factory, which are responsible for querying and managing GStreamer media capabilities within the Rialto server component. It includes methods for retrieving supported MIME types, checking MIME type support, and handling GStreamer caps.

classes.name: GstCapabilitiesFactory
classes.description: Factory class that creates instances of GstCapabilities.

classes.name: GstCapabilities
classes.description: Implements the IGstCapabilities interface, providing methods to query GStreamer media capabilities.

methods.name: createGstCapabilities
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of IGstCapabilities.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of MIME types supported by GStreamer for a given media source type.

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific MIME type is supported by GStreamer.
